Pacifico 2: Playground Town is a social, driving, and life roleplay (RP) experience, best experienced in larger servers.
Taking place in a high-tech alternate universe, Pacifico is one of California's smart cities of tomorrow, with a variety of free cars and homes available for visitors.
Pick a role to play among other players and bring the town to life. Raise a family in the suburbs, shop for groceries and cook a variety of meals, study at the modern Full Moon Bay High School, dance at the club, go camping, fight fires, and more.
